title: Octane Ignitor site data
description: Global site settings in src/_data/site.json. Fields stay present but blank when unused — never delete them.

title.description: Site or business name. Used in the header, page titles, og:site_name, embeds, and as the publisher and author in schema markup.

description.description: Default meta and og:description for pages that don't set their own. Aim for 150–160 characters.

image.description: Default Open Graph image, root-relative (e.g. /assets/images/opengraph.png). Rendered at 1200×630.

logo.description: Site logo, root-relative. An SVG is rasterized to a PNG at build for the BlogPosting publisher logo; a PNG or JPG is used as-is.

url.description: Production origin with no trailing slash (e.g. https://example.com). Drives canonical URLs, the sitemap, robots.txt, Open Graph URLs, and all schema markup.

agency.description: Agency credit shown in the footer.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone of the business (e.g. America/New_York for Atlanta, GA). The Hours component uses it to decide what 'today' is.

postsPerPage.description: Posts per page on the blog, category, and tag listings. Restart the dev server after changing it.

googleAnalyticsId.description: GA4 measurement ID (G-XXXXXXXXXX). Blank disables analytics.

googleAdsId.description: Google Ads tag ID (AW-XXXXXXXXX). Blank disables it. Loads through the same gtag.js as Analytics.

googleAdsConversion.description: Google Ads conversion as AW-XXXXXXXXX/label (the send_to value). Fired when a contact form succeeds. Needs googleAdsId. Blank disables conversions.

metaPixelId.description: Meta (Facebook) Pixel ID, digits only. Blank disables it. Fires PageView on every page and Lead when a contact form succeeds.

header.description: Site-wide header behavior. A page can override either with headerSticky / headerTransparent in its front matter.

sticky.description: Keep the header pinned to the top while scrolling.

transparent.description: Overlay the header on the page's first section (e.g. a hero) with light text. It turns solid once the page scrolls (sticky) or the mobile menu opens.

googleFonts.description: Google Fonts css2 query string without the leading ? or display param (e.g. family=Lato:wght@400;700&family=Montserrat:wght@700). Blank loads no fonts.

social.description: Profile URLs. Feeds the social icons and the sameAs list in schema markup, and the Facebook and Instagram embeds' fallback links. Blank entries are skipped.

business.description: schema.org LocalBusiness details. Blank groups are omitted from the JSON-LD.

telephone.description: Also drives the header's click-to-call button. Blank hides the button.

email.description: Public contact email for schema markup.

address.description: Postal address. Omitted from schema unless at least one of street, city, region, or postalCode is set.

geo.description: Coordinates. Omitted from schema unless both latitude and longitude are set.
